status: FROZEN PROPOSAL — NOT EXECUTED; NO NEW MANUSCRIPT OUTCOMES
objective: Distinguish inadequate 200-trial certification precision from practical rejection-rate inflation; diagnose nominal size separately. Preserve v3.1.
preservation: All v3.1 source, controls, reports and statuses remain byte-identical per PRESERVED-ATTEMPT.json. Fresh outcomes only; old 200 are a separate historical benchmark, never pooled, and failed-only cells are never selected for rerun.

primary.cells: All six Part A cells and both B-Q1 readings, not just failed cells. H/F remain separate.
primary.geometry: Only existing MASKED-v3.1.json, existing declared P1 list and masked support; no raw EVT, zodiac or manuscript outcome files.
primary.engine: Existing attempt C exact convolution unchanged; existing primary available filter unchanged; exact per-trial p, no inner permutation Monte Carlo.
primary.scenarios: JOBS.json, 38 required null scenarios and 8 positives. A availability_only is acknowledged as an independently seeded duplicate marginal law of null_low; never claimed as a distinct stress mechanism. B-Q1 availability-only is not a required null because equal available rates produce a nonzero unconditioned effect.
primary.N: Exactly 10000 fresh draws per required-null cell/scenario and exactly 2000 per positive; total396000. No extension, early pass, seed replacement, adaptive batches or optional stopping.
primary.randomness: np.random.default_rng receives the coordinate seed sequence [913260,reading_index,cell_index,scenario_index,trial]. These are different from old scalar seeds. All coordinates enumerated in JOBS.json. Worker scheduling must not affect draws.
primary.controls: Replay old e.synthetic for null_low/high, additive, junction_only and positive on the frozen cell events. A availability_only uses e.synthetic(null_low) on available events, exactly as v3.1. This is a calibration replication of that candidate, not an expanded token-level qualification.

decision.intervals: 46 simultaneous two-sided exact binomial Clopper-Pearson intervals at family coverage at least95%, Bonferroni over38null+8power cells. Report old pointwise Wilson95 as a descriptive bridge only.
decision.practical_null: U<=.05: CERTIFIED BELOW TOLERANCE. L>.05: EVIDENCE ABOVE TOLERANCE. Otherwise INCONCLUSIVE. Pass a cell only if every required null is certified.
decision.nominal: Separately flag L>test nominal alpha (.05/3 A, .025 BQ1) as EVIDENCE OF NOMINAL-SIZE EXCESS. L<=alpha means no detected excess, not a proof of exact nominal size. Nominal excess in exchangeable null_low/high/junction/available-only blocks nominal-calibration qualification even if U<=.05, pending arithmetic/generator investigation. Additive is a nonexchangeable robustness stress, not guaranteed exact.
decision.power: L>=.80: POWER QUALIFIED. U<.80: EVIDENCE UNDERPOWERED. Otherwise POWER INCONCLUSIVE; no passing headline. Do not enlarge effect.
decision.combination: A cell is qualified only when all practical null gates and positive power gate pass and no exchangeable-null nominal-size alarm occurs. No H/F pooling. Qualification is finite to these geometries and generators.

audit.before_run: Verify preservation and freeze hashes, verify no outcomes in masked file, recompute support against frozen support; regenerate a fixed sample of old seeds/outcome hashes. Check independent combinatorial oracle and production exact test on exhaustive small fixtures.
audit.during_run: Record every trial coordinate, seed tuple, p, flag, degeneracy and outcome hash. Chunk/checkpoint order deterministic; resume only missing fixed coordinates. Degenerate draws remain nondetections in denominator and separately counted.
audit.after_run: Recompute all false flags and fixed trial0 per46 cells with independent combinatorial oracle. On exact floating near-alpha discrepancies use rational/integer oracle; unresolved arithmetic prevents qualification. Retain all failures.

BQ1_boundary: Existing abstract B-Q1 nulls/positive permit successes on blocked followers, so qualification does not certify a physically constrained generative model. Availability-only yields expected aggregate RD +1.284H/+1.166F points and is an alternative to aggregate independence, not an extra null. A separate available-only Currier-A question requires a new manuscript protocol; it is outside this proposal.

BQ2.status: SEPARATE DIAGNOSTIC ONLY; NOT RESCUED BY PRIMARY RUN
BQ2.reason: Outer n200 uncertainty, inner finite-permutation sampling and zero-variance geometry must be separated. H homogeneous-positive10/200 all have pointwise inner-tail upper bounds below .025. Four F homogeneous-positive trials each have one undefined permutation, with observed Q defined.
BQ2.frozen_diagnostic: Reconstruct every one of the existing800 homogeneous trials (2readings x2nulls x200), not only flags. Keep the original10000-shuffle bank as baseline; add two independently seeded10000-shuffle banks per trial. Fresh banks use SeedSequence [913261,reading_index,scenario_index,trial,bank_index_1_or2]. Outcome seeds remain the old saved ones. No new manuscript outcomes, no new heterogeneity method and no zero-variance smoothing.
BQ2.receipts: Report per-bank p, exceedances, flags, undefined counts, context sizes and which variance vanishes. Recompute each undefined context by direct centered-residual sums and high-precision arithmetic to distinguish genuine zero variance from cancellation. Report both all800 denominator and defined-only descriptives; undefined cases cannot disappear.
BQ2.interpretation: Flag changes across banks diagnose inner Monte Carlo sensitivity only. Stable flag excess with a still-wide outer binomial interval is unresolved outer precision. Genuine zero-variance cases are a structural method limitation: more shuffles make discovering rare undefined assignments more likely. Any repair is a separately frozen candidate requiring fresh qualification. No heterogeneity qualification decision or manuscript claim is permitted by this diagnostic.

release: No v3.1 status changes. A later manuscript re-adjudication must be separately labeled retrospective and freeze its scoring/multiplicity/qualification linkage before any new scoring. This proposal authorizes no automatic promotion of old blocked cells.
